title: Question 6.2: Confusion Matrix - Array Initialization
instruction: This code creates a two-dimensional array to store counts of different prediction outcomes.
reveal: This creates a 2x2 two-dimensional array (an array of arrays). It has 2 rows and 2 columns, creating 4 cells total. This will store counts of: [0][0] = actual negative, predicted negative; [0][1] = actual negative, predicted positive; [1][0] = actual positive, predicted negative; [1][1] = actual positive, predicted positive. The 2x2 size matches our two classes: negative (0) and positive (1).
